warning_texts: gate_claims_machine caveats_declared passed CLM-AOV-* on channel-population and sampling-interval topics only; it does not require delivered or net-of-refunds wording, so that gap is an auditor finding rather than a machine miss.
R05 caveats describe an approximate unreadable-shipping share in words and do not bind a claim_id to that share; shipping_total itself is named as unpublished.
Bonferroni is named on both tests with alpha 0.05; both p-values are 0 so a 0.025 cutoff would not change the decision.
Country mix differs by channel but does not reverse the completion or AOV gap in CZ, DE, or PL.
summary: Eight headline claims recompute from quarantine/orders.csv under latest_revision_wins and match the register and metrics, but R02 misstates the dedup rule as first-revision-kept, AOV caveats omit delivered/net-of-refunds, and the AOV test population omits the delivered filter it was computed on.
